newsitem.title: USA: Stewart says added to S&P MidCap 400 index.
newsitem.headline: Stewart says added to S&P MidCap 400 index.

text.p: Stewart Enterprises Inc said Monday it has been selected for inclusion in the S&P MidCap 400 Index by the Financial Information Services group of Standard & Poor's.
As part of the S&P MidCap 400 Services (Commercial & Consumer) industry group, the company is included within the Consumer Cyclicals sector.
The inclusion was effective after the close of trading on June 30.
The S&P MidCap 400 Index consists of 400 domestic stocks chosen for market size, liquidity, and industry group representation.
Stewart provides products and services in the death care industry. It owns and operates 358 funeral homes and 125 cemeteries.
